meta.title: Monstera demo · Your company is a client of an agency, and you use the client portal without managing the account
meta.description: You are Sam Patel, production manager at Acme Coffee Roasters. Acme is a client of Northwind & Co. You follow the projects you are on, read what the agency delivers and ask when something is off.
meta.author: christopherhopkins

siteOptions.blogname: Monstera demo · An agency with clients
siteOptions.blogdescription: Each client is an organization with its own portal. Projects are the spine: discovery, deliverables, status.

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
\Monstera\Plugin::runDevSeed( 'agency' );
$state = (string) get_option( 'monstera_demo_seeded' );
if ( '1' !== $state ) {
	throw new RuntimeException( 'The "agency" program did not finish cleanly (state: ' . $state . ').' );
}
